answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. Each submission hangs on the mirror of a task receipt, and the sable is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. What survives to the gale is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
